blocks.en: Three protectants run through one pipeline: the peptide BoPEP4, the folded protein LEA14 and the enzyme ACC deaminase. Each arrives as a sequence and leaves as coordinates with a grade attached. GRAFT predicts the complex a molecule forms with whatever it has to act on, grades that prediction against experimental structure where one exists, and hands the verdict back to design. It answers whether a molecule can engage its partner; whether that engagement produces a biological response is a question for the bench. Five stages, each built around one or two load-bearing modules, with supporting tools feeding them and a redesign loop running back from the verdict.

blocks.en: The limits are part of the model. A well-scored, stereochemically clean complex says the sequence is capable of the molecular recognition step: the one thing this kind of modeling is able to answer. It does not say the peptide is taken up, survives the apoplast, or that binding fires the downstream immune output. Pattern-triggered immunity is read out in the cell, not in the coordinates, so the redesign loop can only ever optimize for predicted binding, never for function.
blocks.text: The limits are part of the model. A well-scored, stereochemically clean complex says the sequence is capable of the molecular recognition step: the one thing this kind of modeling is able to answer. It does not say the peptide is taken up, survives the apoplast, or that binding fires the downstream immune output. Pattern-triggered immunity is read out in the cell, not in the coordinates, so the redesign loop can only ever optimize for predicted binding, never for function.
blocks.zh: 限制本身就是模型的一部分。一個分數良好、立體化學乾淨的複合體，說的是這條序列有能力完成分子辨識這一步：這也是這類建模唯一能回答的事。它沒有說胜肽會被吸收、能在質外體中存活，或結合就會觸發下游的免疫輸出。模式觸發免疫（pattern-triggered immunity）是在細胞裡讀出來的，不是在座標裡，所以重新設計的迴路只能為預測的結合最佳化，永遠不能為功能最佳化。

blocks.en: Computational tools give real insight into protein engineering and act as decision-making engines for wet lab work, but the process is easy to oversimplify: convenient analysis of inputs and outputs in place of thorough analysis, and no methodology tailored to the project it serves.
blocks.text: Computational tools give real insight into protein engineering and act as decision-making engines for wet lab work, but the process is easy to oversimplify: convenient analysis of inputs and outputs in place of thorough analysis, and no methodology tailored to the project it serves.
blocks.zh: 計算工具確實能讓人看清蛋白質工程，也是濕實驗室工作的決策引擎，但這個過程很容易被過度簡化：用方便的輸入與輸出分析取代徹底的分析，也沒有為它所服務的專案量身訂做方法。

blocks.en: Their outputs depend heavily on the quality of inputs, parameters and underlying assumptions, and that dependence is worse for short, disordered peptides such as Brassica oleracea Plant Elicitor Peptide 4 (BoPEP4), one of our three protectants alongside Late Embryogenesis Abundant protein 14 (LEA14) and 1-aminocyclopropane-1-carboxylate deaminase (ACC deaminase). A workflow that holds up has to account for how and why these tools generate their predictions, not merely run them.

blocks.zh: 它們的輸出高度取決於輸入、參數與底層假設的品質，而對 Brassica oleracea Plant Elicitor Peptide 4（BoPEP4）這類短而無序的胜肽來說，這份依賴更嚴重；BoPEP4 是我們三種保護劑之一，另兩種是 Late Embryogenesis Abundant protein 14（LEA14）與 1-aminocyclopropane-1-carboxylate deaminase（ACC deaminase）。一套站得住腳的流程，必須說明這些工具如何、又為什麼產生它們的預測，而不只是把它們跑過一遍。

blocks.en: The same workflow runs on all three protectants, with the evidence available deciding how far each one gets. For BoPEP4 it predicts and evaluates the ternary signaling complex of the receptor-like kinase PEPR1, the co-receptor kinase BAK1 and the peptide itself. For LEA14 it co-folds the protein against its F-box partner AtPP2-B11, with ASK1 added as a third chain. For ACC deaminase it works from a crystal structure of the enzyme with cofactor and substrate bound, and the engineering question is stability, not recognition. The workflow was designed on the principles of integrative structural biology established by Alexandre Bonvin at Utrecht University, whose lab produced most of the software below.

The opening text describes the method in general terms: what the step is for in any protein engineering pipeline, what it takes as input, and what it can and cannot tell you. The panels that follow describe how it was applied to each protectant. The panels and the map both follow the protectant filter.

blocks.en: Candidate selection begins with the functional requirement, not with a molecule, and surveys gene families instead of single proteins, because a family groups sequences that arose by duplication and therefore tend to share a mechanism even where triggers differ. Four criteria set the shortlist: mechanism match against the stress actually targeted, assayability in the available wet lab, engineerability, and novelty against risk. Candidates failing one are recorded as considered and excluded, because the exclusions define the design space as much as the selections do.

blocks.en: BoPEP4 differs from BrPROPEP4 by one residue and from BnPep4 by two
blocks.text: BoPEP4 differs from BrPROPEP4 by one residue and from BnPep4 by two

Topology and bootstrap support are as published; BoPEP4 is our addition, placed beside BrPROPEP4 because the two differ by a single residue. Every member shown is a Brassicaceae PEP4, and only the Arabidopsis thaliana entry has been characterized experimentally.

blocks.en: The PEP family, and why BoPEP4 over AtPEP1
blocks.text: The PEP family, and why BoPEP4 over AtPEP1
blocks.zh: PEP 家族，以及為什麼選 BoPEP4 而不是 AtPEP1

blocks.en: The BoPROPEP family tree identified candidate PEP peptides including BoPEP4, AtPEP1 and AtPEP3, and let us place BoPEP4 in relation to Arabidopsis instead of taking the peptide directly from the plant. PEP-family peptides are perceived by the same pair of receptor kinases, PEPR1 and PEPR2, so receptor recognition is conserved across the family: a reasonable first signal for which candidates behave similarly, before any experiment.

PEP-family peptides are perceived by the same pair of receptor kinases, PEPR1 and PEPR2, so receptor recognition is conserved across the family: a reasonable first signal for which candidates behave similarly, before any experiment.
blocks.zh: BoPROPEP 的家族樹找出包含 BoPEP4、AtPEP1 與 AtPEP3 的候選 PEP 胜肽，也讓我們能把 BoPEP4 放在與 Arabidopsis 的關係中來看，而不是直接從植物身上取用胜肽。PEP 家族的胜肽由同一對受體激酶 PEPR1 與 PEPR2 感知，因此受體辨識在整個家族中是保守的：在任何實驗之前，這是判斷哪些候選者行為相近的一個合理的初步訊號。

blocks.en: The best-characterized peptide was not assumed to be the best target. AtPEP1 is known mainly for biotic stress, while the project needed measurable abiotic stress, which weather data and sensors detect well. Drought is prominent in Taiwan and is directly signaled by BoPEP4. Abiotic focus also gives direct plant phenotypes such as root length and biomass, where biotic assays would add a second organism and more confounders.

blocks.zh: 我們沒有假設性質鑑定得最清楚的胜肽就是最好的標的。AtPEP1 主要以生物性逆境聞名，而這個專案需要可量測的非生物逆境，也就是天氣數據與感測器偵測得好的那一類。乾旱在臺灣很突出，而 BoPEP4 正是直接對乾旱發出訊號。聚焦非生物逆境也能給出根長、生物量這類直接的植物表現型；生物性逆境的檢測則會多引入第二種生物體與更多干擾因子。

blocks.en: Finally, BoPEP4's variable N-terminal region alongside its conserved C-terminal motif (SSG-x<sub>2</sub>-G-x<sub>2</sub>-N) allows targeted N-terminal edits while preserving the conserved core, and its relative obscurity means the sequence variants are genuinely uncharacterised.

blocks.zh: 最後，BoPEP4 可變的 N 端區域加上保守的 C 端模組（SSG-x<sub>2</sub>-G-x<sub>2</sub>-N），讓我們可以在保留保守核心的前提下針對 N 端做修改；而它相對冷門，也意味著這些序列變體真的還沒有被鑑定過。

blocks.en: The LEA family, and why LEA14
blocks.text: The LEA family, and why LEA14
blocks.zh: LEA 家族，以及為什麼選 LEA14

blocks.en: LEA proteins are associated with abiotic stress and can show substantial intrinsic disorder: some lack a single stable fold and adopt different conformations depending on environment or partner. Ordered or globular members were therefore separated from intrinsically disordered ones, because mutation methods designed for folded proteins cannot be read the same way for disordered peptides, and the family contains both.
blocks.text: LEA proteins are associated with abiotic stress and can show substantial intrinsic disorder: some lack a single stable fold and adopt different conformations depending on environment or partner. Ordered or globular members were therefore separated from intrinsically disordered ones, because mutation methods designed for folded proteins cannot be read the same way for disordered peptides, and the family contains both.
blocks.zh: LEA 蛋白質與非生物逆境相關，而且可能帶有相當高的本質無序性：有些沒有單一穩定的摺疊，會依環境或夥伴採取不同的構形。因此我們把有序或球狀的成員與本質無序的成員分開，因為為摺疊蛋白質設計的突變方法，在無序胜肽上不能用同樣的方式解讀，而這個家族兩種都有。

blocks.en: The ordered, globular LEA14 was chosen, with demonstrated protection against drought, salinity and osmotic stress. Its defined structure gives a stable scaffold for the protein-protein interactions involved in molecular stabilization. Unlike BoPEP4, it does not depend on recognizing one dedicated receptor; its stabilization function can involve many cellular proteins, so a larger structured protein suits the question better. A disordered LEA would instead act through broader, less specific molecular-shield mechanisms.

blocks.zh: 我們選了有序、球狀的 LEA14，它對乾旱、鹽度與滲透逆境的保護作用已有證據。明確的結構為分子穩定化所涉及的蛋白質—蛋白質交互作用提供了穩定的骨架。與 BoPEP4 不同，它不依賴辨識某一個專屬的受體；它的穩定化功能可以牽涉許多細胞內蛋白質，所以一個較大、有結構的蛋白質更適合這個問題。無序的 LEA 則會透過範圍更廣、專一性更低的分子盾牌機制作用。

blocks.en: It also gives a measurable phenotype for wet lab testing, and at over 150 residues it poses a fundamentally different design problem from a short receptor-binding peptide.
blocks.text: It also gives a measurable phenotype for wet lab testing, and at over 150 residues it poses a fundamentally different design problem from a short receptor-binding peptide.
blocks.zh: 它也為濕實驗室測試提供可量測的表現型，而且它有 150 個以上的殘基，與一條短的受體結合胜肽是根本不同的設計問題。

blocks.en: Suggested by Stanford bioengineering assistant professor Jenn Brophy in interview. It fills a real gap: both LEA14 and BoPEP4 fail against heat stress, one of Taiwan's largest abiotic stresses.
blocks.text: Suggested by Stanford bioengineering assistant professor Jenn Brophy in interview. It fills a real gap: both LEA14 and BoPEP4 fail against heat stress, one of Taiwan's largest abiotic stresses.
blocks.zh: 由 Stanford 生物工程助理教授 Jenn Brophy 在訪談中建議。它補上一個真實的缺口：LEA14 與 BoPEP4 對熱逆境都沒有效果，而熱逆境是臺灣最大的非生物逆境之一。

blocks.en: The enzyme is largely specific to ACC, the direct precursor of the plant hormone ethylene. Acting on that one signaling molecule lets it reduce stress-induced ethylene accumulation, and so the growth inhibition that follows, without interfering with other cellular chemistry. It also functions both inside plant cells and outside the roots, which widens the application routes.

blocks.zh: 這個酵素大致上只對 ACC 有專一性，而 ACC 是植物荷爾蒙乙烯的直接前驅物。只作用在這一個訊息分子上，讓它能降低逆境誘發的乙烯累積，以及隨之而來的生長抑制，同時不干擾其他細胞化學反應。它在植物細胞內與根部外都能作用，因此拓寬了應用途徑。

blocks.en: Considered and set aside: proline, CAP peptides
blocks.text: Considered and set aside: proline, CAP peptides
blocks.zh: 考慮過並擱置：脯胺酸、CAP 胜肽

blocks.en: Trehalose was set aside despite its established role in osmotic tolerance: it is already heavily engineered in synthetic biology and offers little differentiation. Proline was excluded because excessive accumulation is associated with cytotoxic rather than purely protective effects, a risk for a system producing protectant continuously. CAP-derived peptides were deprioritised on timeline, since synthesis and validation would not fit the development window.

blocks.en: Two abiotic and two biotic. Two of the four reached the modeling pipeline, and the Pep-family slot changed hands.

blocks.zh: 兩個非生物、兩個生物性。四項中有兩項進到建模流程，而 Pep 家族的那個位置換了人。

blocks.en: NaD1 and MtDef4 were the biotic-stress pair and did not continue. The peptide slot moved from the rice OsPep3 to the Brassica ortholog BoPEP4, which is the crop the project targets.

blocks.en: Every candidate recorded on the team’s protectant sheet, grouped by what happened to it. The shape of the screen is the point: nearly half the list was set aside without an evaluation note, and the three molecules the pipeline runs on are what survived a written assessment.

blocks.en: Literature review here supplies the parameters every later computational step needs, and establishes whether a design is new. Three source classes do the work: sequence databases for canonical sequence and domain boundaries, structural databases for coordinates and the residue range actually resolved, and primary functional literature for the assays and effect sizes. A design citing only the first two can be built but cannot be interpreted.

blocks.en: Resolved the AtPEP1-receptor structure and showed the peptide binding in an extended conformation. This is why our docking inputs treat BoPEP4 as a set of possible conformational states instead of one rigid structure, and it is the reference the receptor-binding interface is read against.

blocks.en: Covers broader strategies for designing and engineering plant-derived peptides. It supported truncation and residue substitution as exploratory axes, and it was used to identify which modifications would produce interpretable changes, since not every mutation is equally informative.

blocks.zh: 涵蓋設計與改造植物來源胜肽的較廣策略。它支持把截短與殘基置換當成探索的軸線，也被用來判斷哪些修改會產生可解讀的變化，因為不是每個突變的資訊量都一樣。

blocks.en: An alanine scan of AtPep1(9–23) and the basis for several of our experimental design concepts. It motivated systematic peptide modification to establish which residues contribute to activity, and it later settled a design question directly: [A18] is fully active in the alkalinization assay at 2.5 nM, ten times the EC<sub>50</sub>.

blocks.en: A truncation series progressively removes portions of a sequence, so comparing variants of different lengths shows whether a region is necessary for the expected interaction. Truncation was therefore both an engineering strategy and a mechanistic probe.

blocks.zh: 截短系列會逐步移除序列的一部分，因此比較不同長度的變體，可以看出某個區域對預期的交互作用是否必要。截短因此既是工程策略，也是機制探針。
丙胺酸掃描作為一種方法

blocks.en: Replaces selected residues with alanine, keeping a simple side chain while removing the original chemistry. The purpose is diagnostic: a substitution that degrades the measured interaction marks a load-bearing position, and one that does not marks a degenerate position available for other modification. With truncation it is the conceptual foundation of the mutation-design workflow.

blocks.zh: 把選定的殘基換成丙胺酸，保留一個簡單的側鏈，同時去掉原本的化學性質。目的是診斷：使量測到的交互作用變差的置換，標出一個承重的位置；不會變差的置換，則標出一個可以做其他修改的冗餘位置。它和截短一起構成突變設計流程的概念基礎。

blocks.en: Expert consultation is only useful if the record separates three things that are easy to merge: what the expert stated, what they recommended, and what was decided afterwards. An open-ended question returns an open-ended answer that cannot be acted on.

blocks.zh: 專家諮詢只有在記錄把三件容易混在一起的事分開時才有用：專家陳述了什麼、他們建議了什麼，以及之後我們決定了什麼。開放式的問題只會得到無法據以行動的開放式答案。

blocks.en: Her interview shaped decisions beyond the choice of ACC deaminase. Asked how to apply stress-sensor and protectant-synthesis logic so plants tolerate heat and salinity, she recommended an OR-gate architecture, and advised working backward from application needs: select a logic gate that is activated under the conditions you care about rather than starting from circuit design. She pointed to two- and three-input logic gates in E. coli as a resource.

blocks.zh: 她的訪談影響的不只是選用 ACC deaminase 這一個決定。當我們問到如何運用逆境感測與保護劑合成的邏輯，讓植物能耐受熱與鹽度時，她建議採用 OR 閘架構，並建議從應用需求往回推：選一個會在你在意的條件下被活化的邏輯閘，而不是從電路設計開始。她也指出 E. coli 中的二輸入與三輸入邏輯閘可以作為資源。

blocks.en: Her ACC deaminase recommendation was scoped to drought and heat. She made no direct claim about salinity, so the OR-gate was researched further to see whether it extends to both heat and salinity.

blocks.zh: 她對 ACC deaminase 的建議只限於乾旱與熱。她沒有對鹽度做出直接的宣稱，因此我們進一步研究 OR 閘，看它是否能同時涵蓋熱與鹽度。

blocks.en: Sequence-level analysis is the cheapest first pass at conservation, variability and potential engineering sites, before any structural modeling. It identifies candidate positions without ranking them, since comparison alone cannot separate a position that varies because it is unimportant from one where two peptides solve the same problem differently.

blocks.zh: 在任何結構建模之前，序列層面的分析是最便宜的第一關，用來看保守性、變異性與可能的工程位點。它只找出候選位置，而不為它們排序，因為單靠比較無法區分：一個位置之所以有變化，是因為它不重要，還是因為兩條胜肽用不同方式解同一個問題。

blocks.en: Multiple AtPEP sequences were aligned to find shared residues and conserved patterns, then compared with BoPEP4. That gives both halves of the engineering brief at once: conserved residues are features to preserve, and the positions where they differ are candidates for mutation and truncation. The AtPEP1–PEPR1 structure provides the context for reading those conserved residues, especially in the C-terminal region that makes concentrated receptor contacts.

blocks.zh: 我們比對多條 AtPEP 序列，找出共有殘基與保守模式，再與 BoPEP4 比較。這一次就同時給出工程工作說明的兩半：保守殘基是要保留的特徵，而兩者相異的位置則是突變與截短的候選。AtPEP1–PEPR1 的結構提供解讀這些保守殘基的脈絡，尤其是在與受體接觸密集的 C 端區域。
結果 · BoPEP4 比對發現
23 個位置，其中 10 個與 AtPEP1 相同

blocks.en: Shaded columns are identical between the two peptides. All ten fall in the C-terminal half; residues 1–6 share nothing.
blocks.text: Shaded columns are identical between the two peptides. All ten fall in the C-terminal half; residues 1–6 share nothing.
blocks.zh: 有底色的欄位是兩條胜肽相同的位置。十個全都落在 C 端那一半；殘基 1–6 完全沒有共同之處。

blocks.en: Both peptides are 23 residues and align without gaps, so every position has a direct counterpart and numbering transfers one to one. This is what allows AtPEP1 structural data to be read onto BoPEP4 at all.
blocks.text: Both peptides are 23 residues and align without gaps, so every position has a direct counterpart and numbering transfers one to one. This is what allows AtPEP1 structural data to be read onto BoPEP4 at all.
blocks.zh: 兩條胜肽都是 23 個殘基，比對時沒有空隙，所以每個位置都有直接對應者，編號可以一對一轉移。正因如此，AtPEP1 的結構數據才有可能讀到 BoPEP4 上。

blocks.en: Ten positions are identical: 7, 9, 12, 15, 16, 17, 19, 20, 22 and 23, all in the C-terminal region. Identity is 10 of 23 across the full peptide, 10 of 17 within residues 7–23, and zero across residues 1–6. That boundary matters because an independent method draws it in the same place: 5GR8 resolves AtPep1 only from residue 7, and our contact analysis found both PEPR1 and PEPR2 engage residues 7–23 while the first six make no receptor contact.

blocks.zh: 有十個位置相同：7、9、12、15、16、17、19、20、22 與 23，全都在 C 端區域。整條胜肽的相同度是 23 中的 10，在殘基 7–23 之間是 17 中的 10，而在殘基 1–6 之間是零。這個邊界之所以重要，是因為另一個獨立的方法把它畫在同一個地方：5GR8 只從殘基 7 開始解出 AtPep1，而我們的接觸分析發現 PEPR1 與 PEPR2 都是結合殘基 7–23，前六個殘基與受體完全沒有接觸。

blocks.en: BoPEP4 also conforms to the conserved motif SSG-x<sub>2</sub>-G-x<sub>2</sub>-N at positions 15–23: Ser15, Ser16, Gly17, Gly20 and Asn23 are all present. The two positions differing inside that window, 18 and 21, both fall in the motif's degenerate positions. The peptide satisfies the family signature and differs only where the family permits variation.

blocks.zh: BoPEP4 在位置 15–23 也符合保守模組 SSG-x<sub>2</sub>-G-x<sub>2</sub>-N：Ser15、Ser16、Gly17、Gly20 與 Asn23 全都在。這個區間內相異的兩個位置，18 與 21，都落在該模組的冗餘位置上。這條胜肽滿足家族的特徵，而且只在家族允許變異的地方不同。

blocks.en: The N-terminal divergence is chemical as well as positional. AtPEP1 opens with ATKVKA, charged; BoPEP4 opens with GILIGS, uncharged and hydrophobic. The whole segment differs in character, not at scattered positions.

blocks.zh: N 端的分歧不只在位置上，也在化學性質上。AtPEP1 以帶電的 ATKVKA 開頭；BoPEP4 以不帶電、疏水的 GILIGS 開頭。整段的性質都不同，不是零散幾個位置不同。

blocks.en: Across the three engineering axes the alignment fixed a starting point for each. N-terminal truncation is supported by two independent lines, zero conservation and zero receptor contact across 1–6. Point substitution has a defined candidate set inside 7–23, with positions 18 and 8 differing from AtPEP1. The conserved repeat analysis has a defined unit at 15–23. Which of those candidates survived is reported in Sprints and Results.

blocks.zh: 在三條工程軸線上，這次比對各自定下一個起點。N 端截短有兩條獨立證據支持：1–6 的保守性為零，與受體的接觸也為零。點置換在 7–23 之內有明確的候選集合，其中位置 18 與 8 與 AtPEP1 不同。保守重複序列的分析在 15–23 有明確的單位。這些候選者中哪些留了下來，寫在「衝刺與結果」。

blocks.en: Why a family alignment was not run for LEA14
blocks.text: Why a family alignment was not run for LEA14
blocks.zh: 為什麼沒有為 LEA14 做家族比對

blocks.en: Sequence conservation alone was less informative for the questions being asked. The LEA family contains substantial structural diversity, including both intrinsically disordered and folded members, so similar sequence patterns do not necessarily correspond to equivalent structural or functional roles.
blocks.text: Sequence conservation alone was less informative for the questions being asked. The LEA family contains substantial structural diversity, including both intrinsically disordered and folded members, so similar sequence patterns do not necessarily correspond to equivalent structural or functional roles.
blocks.zh: 對我們要問的問題來說，單看序列保守性提供的資訊較少。LEA 家族的結構多樣性相當大，既有本質無序的成員，也有摺疊的成員，因此相似的序列模式不一定對應相同的結構或功能角色。

blocks.en: LEA14 was instead analyzed as a specific folded protein: its experimentally characterized structure, residue environment, interaction surfaces, and the vulnerabilities created by our delivery route. That let us connect each proposed mutation to a defined structural hypothesis. The two protectants therefore needed different forms of sequence analysis.
blocks.text: LEA14 was instead analyzed as a specific folded protein: its experimentally characterized structure, residue environment, interaction surfaces, and the vulnerabilities created by our delivery route. That let us connect each proposed mutation to a defined structural hypothesis. The two protectants therefore needed different forms of sequence analysis.
blocks.zh: 我們改為把 LEA14 當成一個特定的摺疊蛋白質來分析：它已有實驗鑑定的結構、殘基環境、交互作用表面，以及我們的遞送路徑所造成的弱點。這讓每一個提出的突變都能連到一個明確的結構假說。兩種保護劑因此需要不同形式的序列分析。

blocks.en: Designed substitutions fall into two categories, and the distinction determines how each is justified. Interface substitutions aim to change a contact and are usually drawn from a structurally characterized homolog, so the substituted residue is one already observed to work in that position. Liability substitutions aim to remove a predicted failure mode: a specific chemical feature that a specific process condition is expected to attack.
blocks.text: Designed substitutions fall into two categories, and the distinction determines how each is justified. Interface substitutions aim to change a contact and are usually drawn from a structurally characterized homolog, so the substituted residue is one already observed to work in that position. Liability substitutions aim to remove a predicted failure mode: a specific chemical feature that a specific process condition is expected to attack.
blocks.zh: 設計出來的置換分成兩類，而這個區分決定了各自要怎麼論證。介面置換的目的是改變某個接觸，通常取自一個結構已鑑定的同源蛋白，因此換上去的殘基是已經被觀察到能在那個位置運作的。弱點置換的目的是移除一個預期中的失敗模式：某個特定的化學特徵，會被某個特定的製程條件攻擊。

blocks.en: The uncharged six-residue GILIGS segment carries zero conservation and zero receptor contact, making the N-terminus the only end that can be trimmed. The C-terminus is off limits: Asn23's free carboxylate is the anchor, and deleting the last residue is documented to compromise binding. Fewer residues to synthesize and export also implies faster secretion, so shortening is a manufacturability gain if binding is retained. The wet lab took this up as a testable claim and is measuring secretion for truncated constructs against wild type.

blocks.zh: 不帶電的六殘基 GILIGS 片段保守性為零、與受體的接觸也為零，使 N 端成為唯一可以修剪的一端。C 端不能動：Asn23 的自由羧酸根是錨點，而刪掉最後一個殘基已有文獻記載會損害結合。要合成與輸出的殘基較少，也意味著分泌較快，因此只要結合力保得住，縮短就是可製造性上的收穫。濕實驗室把這一點當成一個可檢驗的宣稱接手下去，正在量測截短構築與野生型相比的分泌量。

blocks.en: The axis came from a simple idea: BoPEP4 residues not in contact with PEPR1 could be swapped for the residue AtPEP1 has at the same position, restoring residues present in the literature-backed 5GR8 structure. Alignment identified positions 18 and 8 as the candidate set inside the contact region.

blocks.zh: 這條軸線來自一個簡單的想法：BoPEP4 上沒有與 PEPR1 接觸的殘基，可以換成 AtPEP1 在同一位置的殘基，把有文獻支持的 5GR8 結構中的殘基還原回來。比對指出位置 18 與 8 是接觸區域內的候選集合。

blocks.en: BLAST scans suggested the conserved 15–23 region drives receptor binding, motivating a tandem repeat analysis. The countervailing risk is that lengthening the peptide makes it less active-site specific, filling other parts of the receptor.

blocks.zh: BLAST 掃描顯示保守的 15–23 區域主導受體結合，因此促成了串聯重複的分析。相對的風險是：把胜肽加長會使它對活性位置的專一性下降，填進受體的其他部位。

blocks.en: Outcomes for all three axes, including which designs were withdrawn and why, are reported in Sprints and Results.
blocks.text: Outcomes for all three axes, including which designs were withdrawn and why, are reported in Sprints and Results.
blocks.zh: 三條軸線的結果，包括哪些設計被撤回、原因是什麼，都寫在衝刺與結果。

blocks.en: These address liabilities identified in the sequence, not contacts at an interface. LEA14 contains a single cysteine, Cys58, at the start of β3 with no partner. In the reducing plant cytosol an unpaired thiol is inert, but our route sends the protein through the oxidizing extracellular compartment where it can form intermolecular disulfides and dimerise. C58S substitutes a serine of almost identical size that cannot. The test is a gel run with and without reducing agent, so the hypothesis fails visibly if a paired band persists.

blocks.zh: 這些處理的是序列中找出的弱點，不是介面上的接觸。LEA14 只有一個半胱胺酸 Cys58，位在 β3 的起點，沒有配對的對象。在還原性的植物細胞質中，未配對的硫醇基是惰性的，但我們的路徑會讓蛋白質經過氧化性的細胞外環境，在那裡它可能形成分子間雙硫鍵而二聚化。C58S 換上大小幾乎相同、但做不到這件事的絲胺酸。檢驗方式是跑加與不加還原劑的膠體電泳，所以如果配對的條帶仍然存在，這個假說就會明顯失敗。

blocks.en: The sequence also contains exactly one Asp-Pro bond, at 78–79, the most acid-labile peptide bond type. D78E removes it while preserving the negative charge. This is insurance against a process condition, not a gain in activity, and was ranked as such.

blocks.zh: 序列中也恰好有一個 Asp-Pro 鍵，位在 78–79，是最容易被酸水解的胜肽鍵型。D78E 在保留負電荷的同時去掉它。這是對某個製程條件的保險，不是活性上的增益，排序時也是這樣看待。

blocks.en: A third group targets the flexible N-terminal extension at 2–19. Helical wheel analysis gives that segment a hydrophobic moment near 0.37, periodic but below the range typical of membrane-binding amphipathic helices. Face-consistent substitutions could raise it into that range and turn a flexible tail into a membrane anchor. This is recorded as a hypothesis, with the N-terminal truncation built as its matched negative control.

blocks.zh: 第三組針對 2–19 的柔性 N 端延伸段。螺旋輪分析給出這一段的疏水矩約 0.37，有週期性，但低於結合膜的兩親性螺旋的典型範圍。在同一面上保持一致的置換，可能把它提高到那個範圍，把柔性尾端變成膜錨。這記為一個假說，而 N 端截短就建成它配對的陰性對照。

blocks.en: Surface hydrophilicity substitutions were deliberately not pursued. LEA14's GRAVY of +0.056 is unusual for a stress-protective protein and could be lowered, but doing so works against the fold, and the bulk hydration shielding it would serve is the mechanism our feasibility analysis argues is unavailable at any deliverable concentration.
blocks.text: Surface hydrophilicity substitutions were deliberately not pursued. LEA14's GRAVY of +0.056 is unusual for a stress-protective protein and could be lowered, but doing so works against the fold, and the bulk hydration shielding it would serve is the mechanism our feasibility analysis argues is unavailable at any deliverable concentration.
blocks.zh: 表面親水性的置換是刻意不做的。LEA14 的 GRAVY 為 +0.056，對一個逆境保護蛋白質來說並不尋常，也確實可以降低，但這樣做會與摺疊相抗；而它所要服務的大量水合屏蔽，正是我們的可行性分析認為在任何可遞送濃度下都達不到的機制。

blocks.en: LEA14 belongs to the atypical folded LEA_2 group and lacks all of the repeat motifs characterizing the disordered groups. The K-segment is the best-characterized membrane-protection module in the family and occurs in dehydrins, not here. The design fuses one or two K-segments, or Group 3 LEA 11-mer repeats, onto the folded core, giving a stable scaffold with a disordered arm.

The K-segment is the best-characterized membrane-protection module in the family and occurs in dehydrins, not here. The design fuses one or two K-segments, or Group 3 LEA 11-mer repeats, onto the folded core, giving a stable scaffold with a disordered arm.
blocks.zh: LEA14 屬於非典型的摺疊 LEA_2 群，完全不具備那些界定無序群組的重複模組。K 片段是這個家族中性質鑑定得最清楚的膜保護模組，它出現在 dehydrin 中，而不在這裡。這個設計把一到兩個 K 片段，或 Group 3 LEA 的 11-mer 重複序列，接到摺疊核心上，得到一個帶著無序臂的穩定骨架。

blocks.en: The precedent is documented: the mitochondrial LEA protein LEAM is disordered in solution and folds into an amphipathic helix that binds and stabilizes membranes as the cell dries. If the motif confers that behavior instead of the whole protein, grafting it should carry the behavior with it. Two constraints bound the graft: added mass reduces the fraction crossing the cell wall, and every fusion junction is a new site to audit for degron compliance and protease susceptibility.

blocks.en: BAK1 came from 4MN8 chain B, the FLS2–BAK1 complex bound to flg22. BAK1 is a shared LRR co-receptor for multiple plant immune receptors including the PEPRs, and its conserved ectodomain provides the framework for receptor–co-receptor association. 4MN8 does not contain PEPR1, but the resolved BAK1 ectodomain transfers on that conserved architecture.

That gave 41 active residues covering most of the concave LRR face. Passive residues were solvent-exposed positions (relative SASA ≥ 0.40) with a Cα within 8 Å of an active residue, giving 9. The passive set is thin because the active interface is unusually extensive, as expected for an LRR wrapping its ligand.

Arg491 makes no hydrogen bond and no salt bridge on the PDBePISA run; it buries 12 Å² and sits roughly 5 Å away. It is recorded as an interface residue, not a second anchor, and is not used as a pass criterion.

Residue equivalences were read directly from the alignment block, without approximating by nearest neighbor, and then mapped FLS2's 25 BAK1-contact residues onto PEPR1, giving 23 predicted BAK1-site residues.

blocks.en: An initial placement rotating the whole BAK1 domain produced a physically impossible intertwined model. A local Kabsch refit restricted to matched interface residues brought interface RMSD from 4.00 Å to 2.09 Å and raised plausible contact pairs from 61 to 95.

blocks.en: Two of the 23, residues 372 and 395, fall inside the seven-residue peptide-interface core, and several sit near the 487–491 region. In the FLS2 system the ligand's C-terminal region and BAK1's footprint are structurally adjacent, so this is what the architecture would predict. It is reported as consistent with known biology and not as evidence for it, since a geometric transfer could land generically nearby.

blocks.en: On the BAK1 side the restraints are contact-derived from 4MN8: 24 active and 4 passive, comprising contacts with FLS2 and with flg22, where Val54 and Thr58 are shared. Koller and Bent (2014) had been expected to give a second, conservation-based line of support. On a full reading it reports the opposite: the conserved cluster it identifies did not impair FLS2–BAK1 interaction under mutagenesis, and the paper concludes FLS2 and BRI1 use receptor-specific docking sites. The BAK1 restraints therefore rest on a single line of evidence and were weighted accordingly.

blocks.en: Before committing to full runs, DisVis tests whether a restraint set describes a geometrically possible arrangement at all. It scans every rigid-body placement of one partner around the other and reports how many restraints can be satisfied simultaneously, with the volume of accessible interaction space. Each line in a DisVis file is independent, with no OR grouping, so a broad active set is not expected to be fully satisfiable; what matters is how much of the set and how much space stay consistent, measured against a case where the answer is known.

blocks.en: The BAK1-side restraint was planned to rest on two independent lines: the structural transfer from 4MN8, and a repeat-conservation analysis reported by Koller and Bent (2014) as a shared SERK-docking signature. The paper reports the opposite. Site-directed mutagenesis of that conserved cluster did not impair the FLS2–BAK1 interaction, and the residues the paper does validate as required are Gln530, Ser554, Gln627 and Asn674, none of which lie in the cluster. No PEPR1 residue numbers appear in it at all. The co-receptor restraint therefore rests on one line of evidence, the structural transfer, and is weighted as homology-inferred, not cross-validated.

blocks.en: The protein was taken from 1XO8, the solution NMR structure of At1g01470, deposited by the Center for Eukaryotic Structural Genomics. Two features of that deposition matter. It is annotated UNKNOWN FUNCTION, so nothing in the record says where the protein binds anything. And the construct is the whole protein: the deposition cross-references UniProt O03983 across residues 1 to 151, and the coordinates include all 151 with no gaps and no expression tag. What is docked is the complete mature protein.

blocks.zh: 蛋白質取自 1XO8，也就是 At1g01470 的溶液 NMR 結構，由 Center for Eukaryotic Structural Genomics 存放。這份存放紀錄有兩個特徵很重要。它的註記是 UNKNOWN FUNCTION，所以紀錄裡沒有任何地方說這個蛋白質在哪裡結合什麼。另外，構築就是整個蛋白質：存放紀錄在殘基 1 到 151 的範圍交叉參照 UniProt O03983，而座標包含全部 151 個殘基，沒有缺口，也沒有表現標籤。被對接的就是完整的成熟蛋白質。

The spread is almost entirely in the N-terminal tail; the β-sandwich core is one conformation reproduced twenty times.

The transition is abrupt: Leu16 fluctuates by 3.97 Å and Ala18 by 1.16 Å, a factor of three across two residues. The C-terminal six residues sit at 1.61 Å, mobile without being disordered. Glu23 is 10.9% solvent exposed on our own calculation, which is to say buried.

blocks.en: No experimental structure of AtPP2-B11 exists, so this one had to be predicted. The full 257-residue sequence of UniProt Q949S5 was folded with AlphaFold 3 on the AlphaFold Server, templates enabled, and the server returned five models from the submitted seed.

Mean pLDDT on the top model is 90.8: 92.8 over the F-box region, 89.9 over the linker, 90.6 over the PP2 domain. Three stretches fall below pLDDT 70: residues 1–2 at the terminus, and two loops inside the PP2 domain at 179–186 and 196–202.

blocks.en: As an independent check the top model was compared against the AlphaFold Database entry for the same protein, computed separately. The two agree to 1.27 Å Cα RMSD over all 257 residues, and both place the same two loops in their low-confidence regions.

blocks.en: The word ensemble needs qualifying. Mean pairwise Cα RMSD among the five models is 0.94 Å, maximum 1.14 Å, and restricting to the PP2 domain changes nothing at 0.95 Å. The five models are the same conformation five times: they sample the predictor's uncertainty, not the molecule's conformational space. This is the opposite of LEA14, where the deposited models carry genuine variety in the tail.

blocks.en: InterPro places the F-box domain at residues 1–44 and the PP2 lectin-like domain at 92–255, with an unassigned linker between. The F-box is the surface that binds ASK1 inside the SCF complex, so it is not available to LEA14 in the cell. Docking the full chain would let the search place LEA14 on a face that is occupied in vivo, so the input is residues 45–257 with the F-box removed, numbering preserved. That leaves the PP2 lectin domain as the surface under test, which is also the substrate-recognition module by analogy with the solved plant F-box complexes.

blocks.en: Binary docking reduces the complexity of the full system and characterizes one interface at a time. Most of our runs, including the alanine scans and truncation ladders, are built on this workflow because of its relative simplicity.
blocks.text: Binary docking reduces the complexity of the full system and characterizes one interface at a time. Most of our runs, including the alanine scans and truncation ladders, are built on this workflow because of its relative simplicity.
blocks.zh: 二元對接降低整個系統的複雜度，一次刻畫一個介面。我們大多數的執行，包括丙胺酸掃描與截短梯列，都建立在這套流程上，因為它相對簡單。

blocks.en: BoPEP4 was docked against the PEPR1 ectodomain in HADDOCK 2.4. The conformations generated during structure preparation were treated as alternative representations of the flexible peptide, and the active and passive residues from restraint mapping guided the search toward plausible interfaces.
blocks.text: BoPEP4 was docked against the PEPR1 ectodomain in HADDOCK 2.4. The conformations generated during structure preparation were treated as alternative representations of the flexible peptide, and the active and passive residues from restraint mapping guided the search toward plausible interfaces.
blocks.zh: BoPEP4 在 HADDOCK 2.4 中與 PEPR1 的胞外域對接。結構準備階段產生的各種構形被視為這條柔性胜肽的替代表示，而限制條件標定得到的主動與被動殘基則引導搜尋朝向合理的介面。

blocks.en: Sampling was 1000 rigid-body, 200 semi-flexible and 200 water-refined models per run, FCC clustering at 0.60, minimum cluster size 4, peptide fully flexible. Those settings were constant across the nine main binary runs, so their scores are comparable with each other. Confirmation runs used 40/10/10 on the same protocol, because they ask a different question: the cost of a single edit on a fixed pose. Their scores come from far less sampling and are not scored against the main set.

blocks.zh: 取樣為每次執行 1000 個剛體、200 個半柔性與 200 個水層精修模型，FCC 分群門檻 0.60，最小分群大小 4，胜肽完全柔性。這些設定在九次主要的二元執行中保持不變，因此它們的分數彼此之間可以比較。確認性的執行在同一套流程下使用 40/10/10，因為它們問的是另一個問題：在一個固定姿態上做單一修改的代價。它們的分數來自少得多的取樣，不與主要那組一起評分。

blocks.en: Models were clustered by structural similarity and evaluated by HADDOCK score and subsequent structural assessment. The highest-scoring structure was not treated as correct, and structurally plausible clusters were retained for comparison.
blocks.text: Models were clustered by structural similarity and evaluated by HADDOCK score and subsequent structural assessment. The highest-scoring structure was not treated as correct, and structurally plausible clusters were retained for comparison.
blocks.zh: 模型依結構相似度分群，並以 HADDOCK 分數與後續的結構評估來評價。我們沒有把分數最高的結構當成正確答案，結構上合理的分群都保留下來以供比較。

A converged search produces a funnel that narrows towards the bottom left; these runs produce a cloud, and the two bands near 4–6 Å and 11–14 Å are the bound-like and inverted placements.

blocks.en: BoPEP4's activity is not determined solely by PEPR1. BAK1 is the signaling kinase balancing growth and innate immunity, and PEP perception involves receptor–co-receptor association, so the question asked was whether the predicted BoPEP4–PEPR1 interaction could be accommodated in a PEPR1–BoPEP4–BAK1 complex.

blocks.zh: BoPEP4 的活性不是只由 PEPR1 決定。BAK1 是在生長與先天免疫之間取得平衡的訊息激酶，而 PEP 的感知牽涉受體與共受體的結合，因此我們問的問題是：預測出來的 BoPEP4–PEPR1 交互作用，能不能被容納在一個 PEPR1–BoPEP4–BAK1 複合體中。

blocks.en: Docking all three components simultaneously was attempted first and did not run, so the binary result was used as a structural starting point instead: a selected PEPR1–BoPEP4 complex was retained as established and treated as one body, and BAK1 was docked onto it on the interface identified during restraint mapping. This preserved the geometry of the modeled ligand–receptor interaction while searching for a compatible BAK1 orientation. Resulting models were assessed for steric clashes, interface plausibility and consistency with the restraints.

Resulting models were assessed for steric clashes, interface plausibility and consistency with the restraints.
blocks.zh: 我們先試過把三個組成同時對接，但跑不起來，於是改用二元結果作為結構的起點：選定的一個 PEPR1–BoPEP4 複合體被當成已確立的事實，視為單一個分子體，再把 BAK1 對接到它在限制條件標定階段所找出的那個介面上。這樣可以保留建模出來的配體—受體交互作用的幾何，同時尋找一個相容的 BAK1 取向。產生的模型就立體碰撞、介面合理性，以及與限制條件的一致性加以評估。

blocks.en: Two caveats. The ternary run inherits its binary input, so a peptide-register error would propagate uncaught, which is why the binary complex was validated against 5GR8 first. And its two restraint sets are not equally certain: peptide-to-receptor is contact-derived from a solved co-crystal, BAK1-to-receptor transferred from 4MN8 by analogy. The output is a structural hypothesis consistent with the published heterodimerisation biochemistry, not a residue-level prediction.

blocks.zh: 兩點保留。三元執行承接的是它的二元輸入，所以胜肽位置若有錯誤會一路傳下去而不被抓到，這也是為什麼我們先用 5GR8 驗證二元複合體。還有，它的兩組限制條件的確定程度並不相同：胜肽對受體是由一個已解出的共晶體的接觸推導而來，BAK1 對受體則是以類比方式從 4MN8 轉移過來。輸出是一個與已發表的異二聚化生化結果一致的結構假說，不是殘基層級的預測。

blocks.en: HADDOCK searches under restraints that are supplied; a co-folding predictor builds from sequence with none. The two fail for different reasons, so agreement between them is informative. AlphaFold 3 was run on the AlphaFold Server, templates enabled, five models per seed, with nothing from the HADDOCK workflow entering the job. The two tracks run in parallel and never seed each other.

blocks.zh: HADDOCK 是在給定的限制條件下搜尋；共摺疊預測工具則是從序列出發，完全沒有限制條件。兩者失敗的原因不同，所以兩者一致時就有資訊量。AlphaFold 3 在 AlphaFold Server 上執行，啟用模板，每個 seed 五個模型，而 HADDOCK 流程中的任何東西都沒有進入這個工作。兩條軌道並行進行，彼此從不提供起始輸入。

blocks.en: ipTM, pTM, the ranking score and the chain-pair ipTM matrix with interface PAE are recorded, since a single ipTM averages across every interface and a confident pair can hide a failed one. Tracks are compared on interface residue identity, not global RMSD. Solved complexes of the same class are run first under identical settings, and the acceptance threshold is fixed from what they return.

結果 · 信心值不是活性
一條活性低 4000 倍的胜肽，ipTM 是 0.73

blocks.en: Our July 30 audit found AlphaFold 3 returned ipTM 0.73 for a peptide published as more than 4000-fold inactive, against 0.74 for BoPEP4. The metric does not separate a working ligand from a dead one, so it is used only as a structural confidence estimate. Multiple models from one seed are the predictor's uncertainty about one answer, not a conformational ensemble.

blocks.zh: 我們 7 月 30 日的稽核發現，對一條文獻記載活性低超過 4000 倍的胜肽，AlphaFold 3 回傳的 ipTM 是 0.73，而 BoPEP4 是 0.74。這個指標分不出有效的配體與死掉的配體，所以我們只把它當成結構信心的估計值。來自同一個 seed 的多個模型，是預測工具對同一個答案的不確定性，不是構形集合。

blocks.en: This stage earned its place by disagreeing. The K18R design rested on Lys18 carrying the largest electrostatic contribution in the peptide; a trajectory found that contact present in 53.7% of frames across a 2.55 to 9.37 Å swing, and the design was withdrawn. The position-8 design went the same way when a 30 ns run on the wild type ranked Lys8 nineteenth of twenty-three residues by contact occupancy. In both cases the docked pose said one thing and the trajectory said another.
blocks.text: This stage earned its place by disagreeing. The K18R design rested on Lys18 carrying the largest electrostatic contribution in the peptide; a trajectory found that contact present in 53.7% of frames across a 2.55 to 9.37 Å swing, and the design was withdrawn. The position-8 design went the same way when a 30 ns run on the wild type ranked Lys8 nineteenth of twenty-three residues by contact occupancy. In both cases the docked pose said one thing and the trajectory said another.
blocks.zh: 這個階段是靠提出反對意見才站住位置的。K18R 這個設計原本建立在 Lys18 帶有胜肽中最大靜電貢獻之上；一條軌跡發現那個接觸只出現在 53.7% 的影格中，距離在 2.55 至 9.37 Å 之間擺盪，該設計因此撤回。位置 8 的設計也走上同一條路：野生型的一次 30 ns 執行，把 Lys8 的接觸佔據率排在 23 個殘基中的第 19 名。兩個案例中，對接出來的姿態說的是一件事，軌跡說的是另一件事。

blocks.en: That is the point of watching a trajectory instead of scoring a pose. Every design decision above rests on poses that have only been scored, and a contact that appears in a single static model is a hypothesis about the complex, not a measurement of it. Flex is where that distinction is forced.

blocks.en: The work is nine all-atom trajectories, including an AtPEP1 benchmark and an apo receptor control alongside the BoPEP4 constructs. It is reported in full on the Molecular Dynamics page: the systems and their parameters, what each run changed about the design, and the limits of a 30 ns window.

blocks.en: Triage on the map →6Triage: structure scoring
blocks.text: Triage on the map →6Triage: structure scoring
blocks.zh: 在圖譜上看 Triage →6分級篩選：結構評分

blocks.en: Docking returns hundreds of models and will always return a <q>best</q> one, whether or not any of them are right. Triage decides whether a model is worth carrying forward, and it is deliberately built from methods that fail for unrelated reasons. A model passes only if it passes all five. When one fails, which one fails is the diagnosis that shapes the next round of truncations and substitutions.

Triage decides whether a model is worth carrying forward, and it is deliberately built from methods that fail for unrelated reasons. A model passes only if it passes all five. blocks.zh: 對接會回傳數百個模型，而且不論其中有沒有一個是對的，它永遠會回傳一個<q>最佳</q>模型。分級篩選決定一個模型是否值得往下帶，而它是刻意由幾個因互不相關的原因而失敗的方法組成。一個模型只有在五項全過時才算通過。當某一項失敗時，是哪一項失敗，就是形塑下一輪截短與置換的診斷。

blocks.en: Is this the size and chemistry of a real interface?
blocks.text: Is this the size and chemistry of a real interface?
blocks.zh: 這是一個真實介面的大小與化學性質嗎？
這個幾何在化學上合法嗎？

blocks.en: Does it reproduce contacts already known to exist?
blocks.text: Does it reproduce contacts already known to exist?
blocks.zh: 它重現了已知存在的接觸嗎？

blocks.en: HADDOCK groups similar models into clusters, each representing one binding mode. The funnel shape and the cluster population are read before the single best-scoring model, because a lone good score with no supporting cluster usually means the search sampled a lucky pose without converging. A well-populated cluster at the bottom of a funnel is the shape being looked for.

The funnel shape and the cluster population are read before the single best-scoring model, because a lone good score with no supporting cluster usually means the search sampled a lucky pose without converging. blocks.zh: HADDOCK 把相似的模型歸成分群，每一群代表一種結合模式。我們先看漏斗的形狀與分群的成員數，才看單一分數最高的模型，因為一個孤零零的好分數卻沒有分群支持，通常意味著搜尋只是碰巧取樣到一個姿態，並沒有收斂。位在漏斗底部、成員眾多的分群，才是我們要找的形狀。

blocks.en: Why this is not fully applicable: the score discrepancy
blocks.text: Why this is not fully applicable: the score discrepancy
blocks.zh: 為什麼這一項不完全適用：分數的落差

blocks.en: HADDOCK score is a weighted sum of energy terms in arbitrary units, designed to rank models within a run. In our own validation it did not track structural accuracy: one cluster ranked fourth by score reproduced none of the native contacts. This is the single most important reason triage exists as a multi-check process. If the score alone were reliable the other four would not be needed. It is used to judge convergence and to rank within a run, never as evidence that a model is correct.

This is the single most important reason triage exists as a multi-check process. If the score alone were reliable the other four would not be needed. It is used to judge convergence and to rank within a run, never as evidence that a model is correct.
blocks.zh: HADDOCK 分數是能量項的加權總和，單位是任意的，設計目的是在同一次執行內為模型排序。在我們自己的驗證中，它並沒有反映結構準確度：有一個依分數排第四的分群，完全沒有重現任何原生接觸。這是分級篩選之所以是一個多重檢查流程的最重要原因。如果單靠分數就可靠，另外四項就不需要。它只用來判斷收斂程度、在同一次執行內排序，從來不作為一個模型正確的證據。

blocks.en: The prohibition is stronger across constructs of different length, where a longer chain buries more surface and scores better for that reason alone. Comparisons across a truncation series are made per unit of interface, not raw.
blocks.text: The prohibition is stronger across constructs of different length, where a longer chain buries more surface and scores better for that reason alone. Comparisons across a truncation series are made per unit of interface, not raw.
blocks.zh: 在長度不同的構築之間，這個禁令更強，因為較長的鏈埋藏更多表面，單憑這一點分數就會更好。跨截短系列的比較是以每單位介面為基準，不是直接比原始數值。

blocks.en: The same 68 clusters, scored against the fraction of crystal contacts each one recovers. If the HADDOCK score ranked models by accuracy the cloud would run from upper left to lower right. Spearman ρ is −0.21 against fnat and +0.17 against L-RMSD: the correct sign in both cases, but far too weak to pick a model. This is the score discrepancy stated as a number.

If the HADDOCK score ranked models by accuracy the cloud would run from upper left to lower right. Spearman ρ is −0.21 against fnat and +0.17 against L-RMSD: the correct sign in both cases, but far too weak to pick a model. This is the score discrepancy stated as a number.
blocks.zh: 同樣那 68 個分群，依各自取回多少比例的晶體接觸來評分。如果 HADDOCK 分數是依準確度為模型排序，這團雲會由左上走向右下。Spearman ρ 對 fnat 是 −0.21，對 L-RMSD 是 +0.17：兩者的正負號都正確，但弱到遠不足以用來挑模型。這就是把分數落差講成一個數字。

blocks.en: CAPRI is the community standard for grading a predicted complex against a known answer, sorting models into acceptable, medium and high accuracy on contact recovery and ligand placement. It is the only check that measures correctness directly, and it only works where a reference structure exists. For us that is 5GR8. Every protocol change is graded against it, so that any claim about a model with no reference rests on a protocol calibrated on one that has it.
blocks.text: CAPRI is the community standard for grading a predicted complex against a known answer, sorting models into acceptable, medium and high accuracy on contact recovery and ligand placement. It is the only check that measures correctness directly, and it only works where a reference structure exists. For us that is 5GR8. Every protocol change is graded against it, so that any claim about a model with no reference rests on a protocol calibrated on one that has it.
blocks.zh: CAPRI 是把預測出來的複合體與已知答案相比的社群標準，依接觸的回復程度與配體擺放，把模型分成 acceptable、medium 與 high 三個準確度等級。它是唯一直接量測正確性的檢查，而且只有在存在參考結構時才能用。對我們來說那就是 5GR8。每一次流程變更都用它來評等，因此任何關於沒有參考結構的模型的宣稱，都建立在一套已在有參考結構的案例上校正過的流程之上。

blocks.en: A caution: the grade is an aggregate. A model can reach a medium tier while the single most conserved contact in the system is far out of place, which is what the literature check below exists to catch.
blocks.text: A caution: the grade is an aggregate. A model can reach a medium tier while the single most conserved contact in the system is far out of place, which is what the literature check below exists to catch.
blocks.zh: 一點保留：這個等級是總合的結果。一個模型可以達到 medium 等級，而系統中最保守的那一個接觸卻偏離得很遠，這也是下面那項文獻檢查存在的目的。
與 5GR8 晶體結構的 L-RMSD（Å）→

blocks.en: All 68 cluster representatives against the two CAPRI criteria, with the acceptable and medium boxes drawn. Twenty-six clusters reach acceptable and three reach medium. None reaches high, and nothing comes close to the 1 Å L-RMSD that tier requires: the best L-RMSD anywhere in the set is 4.44 Å.
blocks.text: All 68 cluster representatives against the two CAPRI criteria, with the acceptable and medium boxes drawn. Twenty-six clusters reach acceptable and three reach medium. None reaches high, and nothing comes close to the 1 Å L-RMSD that tier requires: the best L-RMSD anywhere in the set is 4.44 Å.
blocks.zh: 全部 68 個分群代表對上兩項 CAPRI 判準，並畫出 acceptable 與 medium 的方框。二十六個分群達到 acceptable，三個達到 medium。沒有一個達到 high，也沒有任何一個接近該等級所要求的 1 Å L-RMSD：整組中最好的 L-RMSD 是 4.44 Å。

blocks.en: PISA reports buried surface area, chemical composition, and whether a contact looks like a genuine assembly or a crystal packing artifact. It answers a question the docking score cannot: is this the right size and character for a complex that exists in solution? A model can score well while burying far too little surface to be real.

It answers a question the docking score cannot: is this the right size and character for a complex that exists in solution? A model can score well while burying far too little surface to be real.
blocks.zh: PISA 報告埋藏的表面積、化學組成，以及一個接觸看起來像真正的組裝體、還是晶體堆積的假象。它回答對接分數回答不了的問題：若這個複合體存在於溶液中，它的大小與性質對嗎？一個模型可以分數很好，但埋藏的表面積遠少於真實該有的量。

blocks.en: PISA was run on the crystal first, so every later number has a reference point. Our docked models are read against those values, which matters for a 23-mer peptide where expectations built on globular interfaces do not transfer.
blocks.text: PISA was run on the crystal first, so every later number has a reference point. Our docked models are read against those values, which matters for a 23-mer peptide where expectations built on globular interfaces do not transfer.
blocks.zh: 我們先對晶體結構跑過 PISA，這樣後面每一個數字都有參考點。我們對接出來的模型就依那些數值來解讀，而這對一條 23 聚體的胜肽特別重要，因為建立在球狀介面上的預期在這裡並不適用。
2039 Å² 與 25 個獨特交互作用

blocks.en: The 5GR8 interface buries 2039 Å² in total, composed 21% apolar, 41% polar, 38% charged, with an inventory of 19 hydrogen bonds and 10 salt bridges amounting to 25 unique interactions once pairs listed in both tables are counted once.
blocks.text: The 5GR8 interface buries 2039 Å² in total, composed 21% apolar, 41% polar, 38% charged, with an inventory of 19 hydrogen bonds and 10 salt bridges amounting to 25 unique interactions once pairs listed in both tables are counted once.
blocks.zh: 5GR8 介面總共埋藏 2039 Å²，組成為 21% 非極性、41% 極性、38% 帶電，清單上有 19 個氫鍵與 10 個鹽橋；把兩張表都列到的配對只算一次後，總計 25 個獨特交互作用。

blocks.en: One property of this interface governs how PISA is read here: its own hydrophobicity test is negative. The peptide side returns a solvation gain of +2.5 kcal·mol−1 and a P-value of 0.585, meaning the interface is less hydrophobic than a random patch of that size. What keeps it together is the polar network, so area and bond inventory are read in place of the ΔiG verdict.
blocks.text: One property of this interface governs how PISA is read here: its own hydrophobicity test is negative. The peptide side returns a solvation gain of +2.5 kcal·mol−1 and a P-value of 0.585, meaning the interface is less hydrophobic than a random patch of that size. What keeps it together is the polar network, so area and bond inventory are read in place of the ΔiG verdict.
blocks.zh: 這個介面有一項性質決定了這裡怎麼讀 PISA：它自己的疏水性檢驗是負的。胜肽那一側回傳的溶劑化增益是 +2.5 kcal·mol−1，P 值 0.585，意思是這個介面比同樣大小的隨機區塊更不疏水。把它維繫在一起的是極性網路，因此我們改看面積與鍵結清單，而不看 ΔiG 的判定。

blocks.en: MolProbity validates the stereochemistry of the coordinates themselves, independent of any docking score. It reports a clashscore for atoms in impossible overlapping positions, rotamer outliers for side chains in conformations real residues do not adopt, and backbone geometry. A model can satisfy every restraint and still be chemically illegal, particularly after the side-chain repacking refinement performs, which is why this check sits outside the energy-based scores.

It reports a clashscore for atoms in impossible overlapping positions, rotamer outliers for side chains in conformations real residues do not adopt, and backbone geometry. A model can satisfy every restraint and still be chemically illegal, particularly after the side-chain repacking refinement performs, which is why this check sits outside the energy-based scores.
blocks.zh: MolProbity 驗證座標本身的立體化學，與任何對接分數無關。它報告 clashscore（原子處於不可能的重疊位置）、rotamer 離群值（側鏈處於真實殘基不會採取的構形），以及骨架幾何。一個模型可以滿足每一條限制條件，卻在化學上不合法，尤其是在精修過程重新堆疊側鏈之後，這也是為什麼這項檢查站在以能量為基礎的分數之外。

blocks.en: The plot maps each residue's backbone dihedrals against the regions physically accessible to a polypeptide. Most residues should fall in the favored regions, and outliers mark strained conformations. For threaded and refined peptide models this is a particularly direct check, because threading imposes a backbone taken from another sequence and this is where the strain from that imposition would show.

For threaded and refined peptide models this is a particularly direct check, because threading imposes a backbone taken from another sequence and this is where the strain from that imposition would show.
blocks.zh: 這張圖把每個殘基的骨架二面角對上多胜肽在物理上可及的區域。大多數殘基應該落在偏好區域，而離群值則標出受應力的構形。對穿線後再精修的胜肽模型來說，這是一項特別直接的檢查，因為穿線強加了一個取自另一條序列的骨架，而這種強加所造成的應力就會在這裡顯現。

blocks.en: The final check asks whether the model reproduces contacts that are already documented. For the PEPR1 interface that is Arg487 engaging the peptide's free C-terminal carboxylate, which was verified directly in the crystal coordinates before using it as a test. A model that fails to reproduce it is wrong regardless of how it scored on everything above, because it has placed the peptide in the wrong register.

For the PEPR1 interface that is Arg487 engaging the peptide's free C-terminal carboxylate, which was verified directly in the crystal coordinates before using it as a test. blocks.zh: 最後一項檢查問的是，模型有沒有重現已有文獻記載的接觸。對 PEPR1 介面來說，那就是 Arg487 結合胜肽游離的 C 端羧酸根，而我們在把它當成檢驗標準之前，先直接在晶體座標中確認過。一個重現不了它的模型就是錯的，不論它在上面每一項的分數如何，因為它把胜肽放錯了位置。

blocks.en: The criterion is calibrated on the crystal, not assumed. Arg487 binds the carboxylate at 2.40 Å; Arg491 is often named alongside it, but on the PDBePISA run it makes no hydrogen bond and no salt bridge at all, so it is reported as an interface residue and not scored.

blocks.zh: 這個判準是在晶體結構上校正出來的，不是假設出來的。Arg487 以 2.40 Å 結合羧酸根；Arg491 常被與它並列提及，但在 PDBePISA 的執行中，它完全沒有形成氫鍵，也沒有鹽橋，因此只報告為介面殘基，不列入評分。

blocks.en: This check is cheap, it is the hardest to fool, and it is the one that caught register errors the energy scores accepted.
blocks.text: This check is cheap, it is the hardest to fool, and it is the one that caught register errors the energy scores accepted.
blocks.zh: 這項檢查便宜，最難被騙過，而且就是它抓到了那些能量分數接受了的位置錯誤。
分級篩選不能確立什麼

blocks.en: A model passing all five checks shows the sequence is capable of the molecular recognition step. It does not show that the peptide reaches the receptor, survives the apoplast, or that binding produces the downstream immune output. Calcium influx, ROS burst, MAPK activation and receptor complex phosphotransfer are all read out in the cell. The redesign loop optimizes for predicted binding; only the wet lab closes the gap to function.

blocks.zh: 一個通過全部五項檢查的模型，顯示這條序列有能力完成分子辨識這一步。它並不顯示胜肽到得了受體、能在質外體中存活，或結合會產生下游的免疫輸出。鈣內流、ROS 爆發、MAPK 活化與受體複合體的磷酸基轉移，全都是在細胞裡讀出來的。重新設計的迴路是為預測的結合最佳化；只有濕實驗室能補上通往功能的那段落差。

blocks.en: Per-run triage outcomes, with each sprint stating which checks it passed and which it failed, are reported in Sprints and Results.
blocks.text: Per-run triage outcomes, with each sprint stating which checks it passed and which it failed, are reported in Sprints and Results.
blocks.zh: 每一次執行的分級篩選結果，以及每個衝刺通過了哪些檢查、沒通過哪些檢查，都報告在衝刺與結果。

blocks.en: ViennaRNA was used on the assumption that reducing mRNA secondary-structure stability around the MF001 ribosome binding site and the start codon improves translation initiation. Performance was assessed by minimum free energy and unpaired-probability predictions, with codon adaptation index values against Bacillus subtilis 168 codon usage. Recoding codons 2 to 31 within the SamyQ signal peptide and the early CDS breaks inhibitory structure in the start+15 and SD core regions, making the start site easier for ribosomes to attach to.
blocks.text: ViennaRNA was used on the assumption that reducing mRNA secondary-structure stability around the MF001 ribosome binding site and the start codon improves translation initiation. Performance was assessed by minimum free energy and unpaired-probability predictions, with codon adaptation index values against Bacillus subtilis 168 codon usage. Recoding codons 2 to 31 within the SamyQ signal peptide and the early CDS breaks inhibitory structure in the start+15 and SD core regions, making the start site easier for ribosomes to attach to.
blocks.zh: 使用 ViennaRNA 的前提假設是：降低 MF001 核醣體結合位與起始密碼子周圍的 mRNA 二級結構穩定性，可以改善轉譯起始。我們以最小自由能與未配對機率的預測來評估表現，並計算相對於 Bacillus subtilis 168 密碼子使用的密碼子適應指數。把 SamyQ 訊號胜肽與 CDS 前段的第 2 到 31 個密碼子重新編碼，可以打斷 start+15 與 SD 核心區域的抑制性結構，使核醣體更容易附著在起始位置。

blocks.en: The approach follows Castillo-Hair et al. (2019) on optogenetic control of B. subtilis gene expression. All analyses ran on the RS-inclusive Window A, modeling the pre-recombination transient mRNA state: RS (28 nt) + MF001 RBS (24 nt) + spacer (1 nt) + SamyQ signal peptide (93 nt) + first 90 nt of CDS.

All analyses ran on the RS-inclusive Window A, modeling the pre-recombination transient mRNA state: RS (28 nt) + MF001 RBS (24 nt) + spacer (1 nt) + SamyQ signal peptide (93 nt) + first 90 nt of CDS.
blocks.zh: 這個做法依循 Castillo-Hair et al.（2019）關於 B. subtilis 基因表現光遺傳控制的研究。所有分析都在含 RS 的 Window A 上執行，模擬重組前的暫態 mRNA 狀態：RS（28 nt）+ MF001 RBS（24 nt）+ 間隔（1 nt）+ SamyQ 訊號胜肽（93 nt）+ CDS 的前 90 nt。

blocks.en: Minimum free energy (kcal/mol) of the most stable secondary structure.
blocks.text: Minimum free energy (kcal/mol) of the most stable secondary structure.
blocks.zh: 最穩定二級結構的最小自由能（kcal/mol）。

blocks.en: Mean unpaired probability over the first 15 or 30 nucleotides from the start codon.

blocks.en: Phase 1 held the 93-nt SamyQ sequence static and optimized the first 15 codons of each passenger gene independently across 8000 random synonymous variants, maximizing a balance score of start+15 plus SD core. Phase 2 addressed elongation via CAI and appended a C-terminal 6×His tag; this was the June and July design, and the tag moved to the N-terminus for BoPEP4 constructs ordered after August 16. Full-length optimization degraded initiation by lowering start+15. Phase 3 departed from standard host adaptation by making SamyQ codons 2 to 31 editable, 45 editable codons once the first 15 CDS codons are included, and drew roughly 50 000 random synonymous variants per construct, each fully re-folded, further reducing structure around the initiation site. The larger library is the larger editable region: Phase 1 sampled 8000 draws over the CDS codons alone.

Phase 2 addressed elongation via CAI and appended a C-terminal 6×His tag; this was the June and July design, and the tag moved to the N-terminus for BoPEP4 constructs ordered after August 16. Full-length optimization degraded initiation by lowering start+15. Phase 3 departed from standard host adaptation by making SamyQ codons 2 to 31 editable, 45 editable codons once the first 15 CDS codons are included, and drew roughly 50 000 random synonymous variants per construct, each fully re-folded, further reducing structure around the initiation site. The larger library is the larger editable region: Phase 1 sampled 8000 draws over the CDS codons alone.
blocks.zh: 第 1 階段把 93 nt 的 SamyQ 序列固定不動，對每個乘載基因的前 15 個密碼子各自獨立最佳化，跨 8000 個隨機同義變體，以 start+15 加 SD 核心的平衡分數為最大化目標。第 2 階段透過 CAI 處理延長階段，並在 C 端加上 6×His 標籤；這是六月與七月的設計，而對 8 月 16 日之後訂購的 BoPEP4 構築，標籤移到 N 端。全長最佳化會降低 start+15，反而使起始變差。第 3 階段偏離標準的宿主適應做法，把 SamyQ 的第 2 到 31 個密碼子設為可編輯，加上 CDS 的前 15 個密碼子後共 45 個可編輯密碼子，並為每個構築抽取 約 50 000 個隨機同義變體，每一個都完整重新摺疊，進一步減少起始位置周圍的結構。程式庫變大是因為可編輯區域變大：第 1 階段只在 CDS 密碼子上抽 8000 次。

blocks.en: Across all four cargoes the pattern is the same: the upstream RBS baseline is largely unchanged, while the initial ORF section undergoes a localized rise in unpaired probability. The targeted breakdown of double-stranded stems opens the start site without needing to unwind the entire preceding sequence.
blocks.text: Across all four cargoes the pattern is the same: the upstream RBS baseline is largely unchanged, while the initial ORF section undergoes a localized rise in unpaired probability. The targeted breakdown of double-stranded stems opens the start site without needing to unwind the entire preceding sequence.
blocks.zh: 在四種乘載上，模式都一樣：上游 RBS 的基準值大致不變，而 ORF 起始段落的未配對機率出現局部上升。有針對性地拆解雙股莖部，能打開起始位置，而不需要把前面整段序列都解開。

blocks.en: SignalP predicts whether a sequence carries a signal peptide, which secretion pathway it targets, and where signal peptidase cleaves. It is used for two purposes.
blocks.text: SignalP predicts whether a sequence carries a signal peptide, which secretion pathway it targets, and where signal peptidase cleaves. It is used for two purposes.
blocks.zh: SignalP 預測一條序列是否帶有訊號胜肽、它導向哪一條分泌途徑，以及訊號胜肽酶在哪裡切。我們用它做兩件事。

blocks.en: First, to confirm each signal peptide and mature sequence junction is cleaved where intended, so the released mature protein has the N-terminus intended. This matters because the mature N-terminal residues follow charge rules affecting secretion efficiency, and one of our substitutions sits in that region.
blocks.text: First, to confirm each signal peptide and mature sequence junction is cleaved where intended, so the released mature protein has the N-terminus intended. This matters because the mature N-terminal residues follow charge rules affecting secretion efficiency, and one of our substitutions sits in that region.
blocks.zh: 第一，確認每一個訊號胜肽與成熟序列的接點都切在預期的位置，讓釋出的成熟蛋白質擁有預期的 N 端。這一點重要，因為成熟蛋白質的 N 端殘基遵循會影響分泌效率的電荷規則，而我們其中一個置換就落在那個區域。

blocks.en: Second, to check that no cleavage site is cryptically predicted inside the mature sequence, which would cut the protectant itself. A construct that passes structural triage and fails this check is not orderable.
blocks.text: Second, to check that no cleavage site is cryptically predicted inside the mature sequence, which would cut the protectant itself. A construct that passes structural triage and fails this check is not orderable.
blocks.zh: 第二，檢查成熟序列內部沒有被隱性預測出切位，否則就會把保護劑本身切斷。一個通過結構分級篩選、卻沒通過這項檢查的構築，是不能下訂的。

blocks.en: Predictions were run across the whole signal peptide panel instead of one assumed choice, because the best signal peptide differs for each cargo and cannot be predicted from first principles.
blocks.text: Predictions were run across the whole signal peptide panel instead of one assumed choice, because the best signal peptide differs for each cargo and cannot be predicted from first principles.
blocks.zh: 預測是跨整個訊號胜肽組合跑的，而不是只跑一個假定的選擇，因為最好的訊號胜肽對每一種乘載都不同，無法從基本原理預測。
